name: chart-area

frames.best_why: Shows all three chart cards fully drawn and unobstructed, so their different fills are easy to compare.

tagline: A row of area charts with gradient, legend and step variants.
summary: Three small analytics cards each holding an area chart of visitor numbers. Gradient and stacked fills sit beside a stepped version, and hovering a chart shows a tooltip.
appearance: Three bordered dark cards sit side by side, each with a title, a grey area chart on faint horizontal gridlines and a small footer stat. Chart shapes differ: smooth filled humps, a two-tone stack and a blocky step line.
behaviour: Hovering over a chart reveals a small tooltip listing the month and values. The legend card's entries use dots, and the step chart holds each value flat before jumping.
demo_content: Visitor charts for January to June 2024 labelled Desktop and Mobile, with a Trending up 5.2% footer.
use_when: A dashboard needs several small area charts that stay readable in compact cards.
avoid_when: The cards carry fixed demo data and English copy, so each variant needs its data and labels replaced.
customise: Data arrays, chart configs and titles are written per variant in the source; swapping datasets means editing the file.
weight_why: Three small SVG charts with six points each; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Charts use an accessibility layer with names, but the tooltip data is not reachable without a pointer.

polish_why: Neat standard chart cards, but all grey and fairly generic.
